items.text: D1: sibling RecoveryFlowProjector at services/recovery_flow_projector.rs (controller tracking Open->Quorum->Effective state machine) vs accumulator AttestationProjector; call site gains prefix-routing for recovery-request/key-revocation/identity-freeze signals

D1: attestation:revocation-vote + attestation:recovery-approval continue via AttestationProjector (vote-children land in attestations accumulator); only governance-action openers + key-revocation effective events go to the sibling; EPR W2D key_revocations writer co-located in RecoveryFlowProjector

D2: duality - existing revocation-attestation.schema.json (Category C operational) stands; slim signal carries actionHash + progress state (currentVotes/requiredVotes/thresholdReached), no inlined contentEnvelope; consumers read governance_actions table for threshold config
D2: EPR D3 committed to duality - IntegrityNotify pipeline reads slim signal, no contentEnvelope expected, no cross-sprint schema coordination needed
D3: retire feature/recovery-m4-fast-path-revocation branch outright (zero unique commits, strict ancestor of dev; a2o + sweettest scenarios already on dev); git branch -d (not -D) safety check

D4: manifest-declared Shamir custodian discovery (custodian CIDs on DHT at setup time, resolved to PeerId via peer_identity_bindings, dialed via ShamirShareCodec) vs peer-advertised; deterministic-without-elohim + grandma-standard (recovery must not fail if custodian offline)

D4 Stage 4a wiring: add shamir_share_protocol RequestResponse<ShamirShareCodec> to ElohimStorageBehaviour following trust_protocol pattern; dial by manifest PeerId not gossipsub scan; custodian_cid is replay-prevention not discovery

Open: D4 sub-question - is custodian identity committed in governance-action:recovery-request (recovery-time) or separate governance-action:shamir-custody-setup (onboarding); resolve as Stage 4b pre-condition
Open: D1 sub-question - confirm exact call site file+line of central signal dispatcher gaining the prefix-routing step (Stage 2 pre-condition)
